notes: WHEN keywords learned AND. '18+' combined with other keywords now gates instead of ORs: '18+, feet' means a mature photo that is also about feet — previously it loaded on every mature photo, which made content-specific LoRA collections (poses, positions, situations) impossible to keep apart. '18+' alone still means every mature photo, plain keywords still OR, and the photo director still can't pick an 18+-gated LoRA into a SFW picture.
